notes:
POC summary and current status:
- Org: digital merchandising + personalization platform for mid-large retailers. Heavy emphasis on sub-200ms tail for streaming chat + API calls to power onsite checkout assistant.
- Eng contact: VP Eng (Jordan Meyers) + ML lead (Priya Desai). AE: Maya Chen. SE: Carlos Ruiz. CSM lined up if pilot expands: Lina Park.
- Timeline: 2024-07-10 intro call; 2024-07-21 technical scoping (Fireflies FF-20240721-4982). POC started 2024-07-25 (2-week bench + integration). 2024-08-01 canary traffic run. 2024-08-10 joint diagnostics call (Fireflies FF-20240730-5129).
- Tech findings (from SE bench):
  * p95 end-to-end latency for streaming sessions consistently 420-520ms vs customer SLO 180-220ms.
  * Streaming chunking causes rebuffering spikes at token boundaries; client sees 2-3x perceptible pauses.
  * Peak throughput OK in batch tests, but per-connection NVMe I/O and websocket serialization add jitter.
  * Attempts: quantized model variant, tighter batching, KV cache warmers — reduced mean latency but p95 still ~350ms.
  * Hypothesis: networking path + runtime scheduling on their private VPC (multi-tenant infra) amplify tail. Might need co-located gateway + reserved instances or on-prem footprint.
- Business impact: Retail checkout assistant demo suffers; product team says "latency kills conversion" and will not proceed to paid pilot until p95 <250ms.
- Sales notes:
  * Customer evaluating OpenAI streaming (they saw better perceived latency via gRPC streaming demo).
  * Procurement flagged potential budget freeze for Q3 unless immediate ROI (conversion lift) proven.
  * Security/compliance team initiated longer data residency audit; delays infra access.
- Risks: no internal champion committed to unblock infra changes; security team unwilling to sign org-level exception for co-located gateway.
- Proposed next steps we suggested:
  1) 24h focused perf run with dedicated co-located gateway (SE+Cust infra) — needs creds and 24h maintenance window.
  2) Option to pilot Redwood Dedicated with reserved pool (cost estimate attached in drive doc).
  3) Provide a perceptual streaming demo (short chunks + client side buffering) to show UX improvements while infra work proceeds.
- Customer quote from call 2024-08-10: "If we can't get the p95 under 250ms, we won't move to pilot — it's a showstopper for checkout."
- Current status: stalled -> customer unresponsive since 2024-08-12 after procurement pushed back; we marked as high risk for Q3 close.
